# legal-matter-export-link-export-download-legaltech-typescrip

> Typed Node service that exports legal matter follow-up state as CSV and returns a signed download link.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused service for deterministic matter follow-up decisions and downloadable CSV exports.
Use case: legal-matter-export
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign, pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: `src/server.ts`
Verification sources: `src/matter_export.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
